summary: Jones Ventures INTL Acquisition1 Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and rights commencing September 3, 2026. This is a routine procedural step in a SPAC's lifecycle, allowing separate trading of components post-IPO. No fractional rights will be issued. The units continue to trade as JONEU, with shares and rights under JONE and JONER. No deal terms, premiums, or special-situation elements are present. The filing is administrative and not a special situation.
